about.title: About Me
about.p1: Master 1 Computer Science student specializing in Systems Design and Cybersecurity at UPEC, I combine solid professional experience in full-stack development and DevOps with a strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science and cybersecurity.
about.p2: With 2+ years of apprenticeship at CGI France, I developed an infrastructure management portal in Java/Vue.js, automated the management of over 2,000 virtual machines and built a self-provisioning application that reduced deployment delays from 2 weeks to 2 hours (-98%).
about.p3: TOP 6 finalist at the AgentsIRL 2025 Hackathon with TruthTrace, an automated AI debate analysis application combining multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph), audio transcription (OpenAI Whisper) and semantic analysis (Mistral), deployed on Google Cloud Run.
about.p4: Currently working on an IoT project (ESP32 weather station + MicroPython + MQTT) and deepening my knowledge in offensive and defensive cybersecurity as part of my Master's program.
about.bilingual: Native French-Chinese bilingual (母语), an asset for communication within international teams and technical translation.
about.languages: Languages: French (Native), Mandarin Chinese (Native / 母语), English (B2), Japanese (Basics), Korean (Basics)
about.interests: Open to discussing opportunities in AI/Data Science, DevOps, Cybersecurity or IoT.

truthtrace.subtitle: AI Debate Analysis
truthtrace.description: Full-stack application for automated AI analysis of debate videos. Automatic transcription (Whisper), speaker identification, argument classification (Mistral), automated fact-checking and multi-dimensional evaluation.

detail.context: Project developed during the AgentsIRL 2025 Hackathon, an AI competition bringing teams together around creating intelligent agents. The goal was to design a tool capable of automatically analyzing debate videos to extract, classify and verify arguments made by each speaker.
detail.role: Development of the analysis pipeline: integration of multi-agent orchestration with LangGraph, implementation of automated fact-checking and multi-dimensional speaker scoring.
challenges: Orchestrating multiple AI agents (transcription, diarization, classification, fact-checking) into a coherent pipeline via LangGraph
Speaker identification and separation in debate audio files using Pyannote.audio
Argument classification into categories (claims, evidence, rebuttals) using Mistral
Containerized deployment on Google Cloud Run with memory and processing time constraints
detail.results: TOP 6 ranking at the hackathon. Functional application with interactive color-coded timeline, 4-level fact-checking verification and speaker scoring across 6 dimensions (factual accuracy, evidence quality, persuasiveness, etc.).

esp32.subtitle: IoT Weather Station
esp32.description: Real-time environmental data collection and analysis system. Complete architecture: ESP32 + DHT11 sensor, MicroPython firmware, MQTT protocol, Flask + PostgreSQL backend, fully containerized with Docker.

detail.context: Personal project aimed at designing a complete end-to-end IoT system: from sensor data collection to web visualization, including communication protocol and database storage.
detail.role: Design and development of the entire architecture: ESP32 firmware, MQTT broker, backend API and Docker containerization.
challenges: ESP32 firmware programming in MicroPython with WiFi connection and MQTT protocol management
Setting up an MQTT broker for real-time communication between sensor and server
Flask API design with PostgreSQL storage for measurement history
Containerization of all services (backend, database, broker) with Docker Compose
detail.results: Functional system collecting temperature and humidity data in real-time with history accessible via REST API. Reproducible architecture thanks to Docker.

security.subtitle: Cybersecurity Tools
security.description: Multithreaded Python port scanner for identifying open services and detecting versions. Password strength audit script with dictionary attack capabilities.

detail.context: Development of cybersecurity tools as part of the Cybersecurity Master's program at UPEC. The goal is to understand offensive techniques in order to better design defenses.
detail.role: Complete design and development of scanning and auditing tools.
challenges: Implementation of a multithreaded port scanner to parallelize TCP connections and speed up detection
Service version detection through response banner analysis
Password audit script using dictionaries and mutation rules (substitutions, number appending)
Managing timeouts and result reliability on variable networks
detail.results: Scanner capable of analyzing all 65,535 ports of a target in minutes. Audit tool identifying weak passwords according to ANSSI criteria.

iaqa.subtitle: QA Fine-tuning on SQuAD
iaqa.description: Fine-tuning Question Answering models on the SQuAD dataset with web deployment. Full pipeline: model training, performance evaluation, and containerized web interface with Docker.

detail.context: University project (SAE) aimed at exploring fine-tuning of language models for extractive Question Answering. The SQuAD (Stanford Question Answering Dataset) serves as a benchmark for training and evaluating models.
detail.role: Development of the training pipeline, model evaluation and containerized web deployment setup.
challenges: Fine-tuning Transformer models on the SQuAD dataset with hyperparameter optimization
Rigorous performance evaluation (F1-score, Exact Match) on test sets
Development of a web interface for asking questions on a given context
Containerization with Docker and CI/CD pipeline setup via GitHub Actions
detail.results: Fine-tuned model with competitive performance on SQuAD. Deployed web application enabling real-time inference on arbitrary texts.

gpt2.subtitle: Conversational AI Chatbot
gpt2.description: Intelligent chatbot based on GPT-2 with custom fine-tuning. Performance comparison between generic and specialized models. User interface built with Gradio.

detail.context: University project (SAE) carried out in a team of 7, aimed at creating an intelligent conversational chatbot based on the GPT-2 model. The project includes model exploration, data collection, specialized fine-tuning and comparative performance analysis.
detail.role: Participation in model fine-tuning, Gradio interface development and comparative analysis of results between generic and specialized models.
challenges: Exploration and understanding of GPT-2 architecture with TensorFlow/Keras
Collection and preparation of specialized training data
Model fine-tuning with limited GPU resource management
Objective performance comparison between pre-trained and fine-tuned models
Development of an intuitive user interface with Gradio
detail.results: Functional chatbot with Gradio web interface. Documented comparative analysis showing improved responses after fine-tuning on the specialized domain.

dracorporation.subtitle: Collaborative Web Application
dracorporation.description: Web application developed in a team of 5 (university project S3). PHP/Python architecture with PostgreSQL database. 199 commits reflecting structured team development.

detail.context: University project from semester 3 of the BUT Computer Science program, carried out in a team of 5 students. The goal was to develop a complete web application following collaborative development best practices.
detail.role: Backend development and PostgreSQL database integration. Active participation in development with regular contributions to the Git repository.
challenges: Development of a multi-language web application (PHP backend, Python scripts, HTML/CSS frontend)
PostgreSQL database design and management with stored procedures (PL/pgSQL)
Team coordination with Git branch management and conflict resolution
Integration of Python scripts for server-side data processing
detail.results: Functional web application delivered on time. 199 commits reflecting structured development and effective team collaboration.

game.subtitle: Python Game
game.description: Game developed in Python with modular architecture: game engine, data management and analyzer. Graphical interface with visual assets and progression system.

detail.context: Game development project in Python carried out as part of the BUT Computer Science program. The goal was to apply modular programming principles and object-oriented design.
detail.role: Design of the modular architecture and complete game development.
challenges: Modular architecture separating game engine (main.py), business logic (cake.py), data management (tab_cakes.py) and analysis (analyseur.py)
Graphic asset management (illustrations, backgrounds, victory screen) and interface integration
Implementation of a progression system with multiple levels
Code structuring for maintainability and extensibility
detail.results: Functional game with graphical interface, progression system and victory screen. Modular and easily extensible codebase.

maths.subtitle: Mathematical Analysis
maths.description: Mathematical and computational analysis project built with Python and Jupyter Notebook. Demonstrates analytical and problem-solving skills.

detail.context: University project (SAE) combining applied mathematics and programming. The goal was to solve complex mathematical problems using computational tools in Python.
detail.role: Mathematical modeling, algorithm implementation and results analysis.
challenges: Modeling mathematical problems into Python algorithms
Using Jupyter Notebook for interactive analysis and visualization
Numerical validation of results and mathematical interpretation
Clear documentation of the analytical approach
detail.results: Complete mathematical analysis with results documented in an interactive Jupyter Notebook and exported HTML version.

raspberry.subtitle: Raspberry Pi OS Configuration
raspberry.description: Configuration and administration of an operating system on Raspberry Pi. Complete documentation of installation process, network configuration and Linux service management.

detail.context: University project (SAE) aimed at mastering Linux system administration on Raspberry Pi embedded hardware. The goal was to configure a complete operational system from scratch.
detail.role: Installation, configuration and complete documentation of the Raspberry Pi system.
challenges: Linux OS installation and configuration on Raspberry Pi
Network configuration (static IP, SSH, firewall)
Linux service management (systemd, cron, logging)
Writing comprehensive technical documentation of the process
detail.results: Operational Raspberry Pi system with secure SSH access, configured services and detailed technical documentation (PDF) covering the entire process.
